card.name: Digits and hyphens inside numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit or hyphen partway through a year, date range, version number or phone number. It fires most on the middle digits of years such as 1985 or 2011.

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: A middle or late digit within a four-digit year in citations or dates.

modes.label: Hyphen inside a number
modes.description: A hyphen joining parts of a phone number, date or name with a number.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number, such as a year or phone number, before the rest of the number is written.
